name: CBAMBlock

channel.description: number of channels; defaults to x.shape[1]

kernel_size.description: kernel size for channel attention conv1d; default 3

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, channel=None, reduction=16, kernel_size=3):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    if channel is None:
        channel = x.shape[1]
    b, c, h, w = x.size()
    conv = nn.Conv1d(1, 1, kernel_size=kernel_size, padding=(kernel_size - 1) // 2, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    y = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1)
    y = conv(y.squeeze(-1).transpose(-1, -2))
    channel_att = torch.sigmoid(y)
    channel_att = channel_att.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(-1)
    channel_out = x * channel_att.expand_as(x)

    avg_out = torch.mean(channel_out, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    max_out, _ = torch.max(channel_out, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    spatial_att = torch.sigmoid(avg_out + max_out)
    spatial_att = spatial_att.expand_as(channel_out)

    out = channel_out * spatial_att
    return out
